findings.passage: Georgia requires a valid photo ID to vote in person. See the accepted ID list below.
findings.note: Campaign how-to-vote page, issued under the campaign's name. It states the existing Georgia in-person photo ID rule as a voter instruction and lists accepted IDs, including a free voter ID card from the county registrar or DDS. It does not say whether he wants the rule kept or changed. Page has no visible date; it cites the Oct 5, 2026 registration deadline.

findings.passage: For absentee voting, you'll need to provide your Georgia driver's license number or state ID number on your application.
findings.note: Same campaign page. It tells voters that an ID number is needed on an absentee ballot application in Georgia, and that no photo ID copy is mailed in. Voter instruction, no stated preference on the rule.
subjects: ID number to request absentee ballot
